title: Kura Sushi USA Adds Smoky, Savory Flavors with a New Kura Reserve Menu This October
body_markdown:
# Kura Sushi USA Adds Smoky, Savory Flavors with a New Kura Reserve Menu This October


Kura Revolving Sushi Bar guests can enjoy a barbecue-inspired lineup that includes Seared Sakura Pork Bacon, Sukiyaki Beef, Wagyu Rib Eye Cap Steak, and more


October 14, 2026


Fire up your appetite![Kura Sushi USA, Inc.](https://kurasushi.com/) , the nation's largest brand of revolving sushi restaurants, will be serving a new Kura Reserve menu with bold flavors of seared cuisine starting this Friday, Oct. 16 through Thursday, Oct. 29, while supplies last. Available at Kura Revolving Sushi Bar restaurants nationwide, the BBQ-inspired menu features **Seared Sakura Pork Bacon, Seared Sakura Bacon with Dashi Ponzu, Sukiyaki Beef Roll** , and **Wagyu Rib Eye Cap Steak,** alongside the return of past favorites including **Bluefin** **Tuna Otoro, Crispy Chicken Dorayaki,** and **Hokkaido Pumpkin Mochi Sundae.**


**Sizzle, Smoke, and Sushi:**


- **Seared Sakura Pork Bacon:** Rich and savory Sakura pork bacon, seared and layered over Kura specialty rice, topped with an aromatic touch of bright yuzu pepper.
- **Seared Sakura Bacon with Dashi Ponzu:** Two indulgent pieces of rich Sakura bacon seared and layered over Kura specialty rice, balanced with a fresh drizzle of tangy dashi ponzu finished with green onion.
- **Sukiyaki Beef Roll:** Savory sukiyaki beef paired with cucumber and avocado, wrapped with Kura specialty rice and seaweed, topped with sesame seeds, yakiniku sauce and green onion.
- **Wagyu Rib Eye Cap Steak:** Wagyu rib eye cap steak on Kura specialty rice topped with green onion and sesame seeds.


“We’re turning up the heat with a Kura Reserve lineup that brings big, smoky, barbecue energy to prove premium flavors belong on the revolving belt,” said Newton Hoang, Vice President of Marketing at Kura Sushi USA, Inc.


Complementing this limited-time menu are **Crispy Chicken Dorayaki** —fluffy dorayaki bun filled with juicy crispy chicken, fresh green leaf lettuce, pickled carrots and creamy mayonnaise, **Hokkaido Pumpkin Mochi Sundae** — Hokkaido pumpkin mochi paired with creamy vanilla ice cream, sweet red bean paste, topped with Japanese green tea sauce and green tea powder, and Kura Reserve Standard nigiri sushi favorite **Bluefin Tuna Otoro** —tender bluefin tuna belly.


Kura Reserve is a limited-time culinary experience platform that features seasonally inspired creations and complements Kura Sushi’s always-on menu available for dine-in only.


For more information about the Kura Reserve limited-time menu and to make a reservation at participating Kura Revolving Sushi Bar restaurants, visit **[kurasushi.com](https://kurasushi.com/)** and download the **[Kura Sushi Rewards app](https://kurasushi.com/rewards)** to roll into delicious loyalty perks.


**About Kura Sushi USA, Inc.**


Kura Sushi USA, Inc. is the nation’s largest brand of revolving sushi restaurants that serves authentic Japanese cuisine and delivers a joyful dining experience with more than 90 locations in 24 states and Washington D.C. Utilizing advanced innovation to enhance service speed and accuracy, guests have a wide variety of more than 100 menu items at their fingertips via conveyor belt service inclusive of sushi, sashimi, tempura, noodles, desserts, and more, made with high-quality ingredients free of artificial colorings, preservatives, seasonings and sweeteners. Kura Sushi USA, Inc. was established in 2008 as a subsidiary of Kura Sushi, Inc., a Japan-based revolving sushi chain with more than 600 restaurants internationally and 45 years of brand history. For more information about Kura Sushi USA, visit[kurasushi.com](https://kurasushi.com/) , follow Kura Sushi USA on[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/kurasushiusa) ,[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/kurasushi_usa/) ,[TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@kurasushiusa) &[X](https://x.com/kurasushi_usa) , and download the[Kura Sushi Rewards app](https://kurasushi.com/rewards) to make a reservation and roll into delicious loyalty perks.
